title: Cap Lambda Timeout and Concurrency
scenario: A runaway function burned through the free tier. Cap timeout and concurrency, and remove wildcard IAM.

focus.title: Complete the aws_lambda_function resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_lambda_function.

hints.why: Lambda packages compute as a small, event-driven unit. The code artifact, execution role and trigger are the contract to get right.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_lambda_function" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_lambda_function. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use Lambda for short-lived event handlers or glue code where managing a server would add cost and operational noise.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_lambda_function" "this"`. Use this code shape: function_name; runtime; handler; filename; memory_size; timeout; reserved_concurrent_executions; environment { variables }. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
